title: [spec-gap][R-11-068] Unified UI (spec 17.8) unimplemented: 4+2 screens, custody indicators, status bar, Observe-driven UIs, e-ink/web surfaces
description: Spec 17.8: all LICHEN UIs share one information architecture: 4 primary screens (Messages/Map/Peers/Status) + 2 secondary (Settings/Keys); persistent status bar (battery pct, RPL rank/hops, GNSS time, unread count, TDMA sync state); custody indicators Sending/Sent/Delivered/Expired; UIs are CoAP Observe clients that never poll. Classification: not-implemented/divergent across every surface. Evidence: rust TUI tabs are Node/Radio/RfHealth (lichen-tui/src/main.rs:131-147), status bar is tab hints (main.rs:369-382), and it GETs /status on a 5s poll loop (main.rs:113-126,415-420) while lichen-coap client has no Observe (client.rs:6); map.rs/message.rs/status.rs spec-like screens are unwired dead code with no Expired custody state (message.rs:20-56); python native TUI is Observe-driven (lichen/tui/native/app.py:107,1112-1141) with battery/time/unread status but no Map/Peers/Keys screens; lichen-mobile is a chat-only skeleton with simulated send/ack (chat_page.dart:54-61) and no CoAP; no e-ink display driver at all (lichen/drivers/ has no display; hmi is LED-only) and no web dashboard (only sim/websocket.py:215 simulator observer). TDMA desync FSM exists (tdma.c:96-188, vectors tdma_ccp_fsm.json) but is not exposed in /status. Suggested placement: wire rust TUI to Observe client + spec screen set (message.rs/map.rs already drafted), expose TDMA sync + rank in /status, then port to e-ink display driver and mobile CoAP client.
